header: One named row, one bar, one typed percentage
lead: The digits in each row's value become a custom property on that row, and the fill reads it as a width. There is no script, no chart library and nothing measured — a bar here is a number an editor wrote down.
note: Rows are independent percentages. Use Distribution Bars when they are shares of one total, and Goal Meter when a single target is the whole story.

metrics.title: A full row
metrics.text: Clamped at the track width, so a value typed as 140 does not run past it.

metrics.title: A partial row
metrics.text: The figure is written out beside the label; the bar only repeats it.

metrics.title: An empty row
metrics.text: A row with nothing typed in it reads as zero rather than as full.
